# Carbon Copy (cc)

> Carbon Copy (cc) rebuilds the apps developers already code with, a VS Code style editor, a wall of terminal tiles, an inbox of what is waiting on you and browser panes, as one free, open-source Windows desktop app with coding agents built in. It runs coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and others, 7 in all) side by side, each in a terminal a background service owns, so you control many agents from one window. The Wall moves the agent waiting for you to the front. Agents can drive browser panes and Windows app windows you give them; risky actions stop for your approval. Local only: no account, no telemetry. Pre-release, installs from source, Node 24.16+. Older names: Ouros, MetaTrooper.

Carbon Copy Pro (cc Pro) will be the one paid part: a separate private add-on at A$19 a month, not on sale yet. It gives every agent tools about the other tasks in a project: what else is running, another task's last lines and changed files, which task already changed a file, and a shared note board. The pipe methods it uses are public, so anyone can build their own. It includes Proof, which checks whether an agent's tests catch bugs by breaking the changed lines on purpose and rerunning the tests. Every safety feature in cc is free.

## Answers

- [How to control many coding agents from one place]({{SITE}}/answers/control-many-coding-agents-in-one-place.html): the editor, terminals, inbox and browser as one window, with agents built in.
- [cc vs plain terminals]({{SITE}}/answers/cc-vs-plain-terminals.html): when terminals are enough and when cc helps.
- [How to run several Claude Code sessions at once]({{SITE}}/answers/run-several-claude-code-sessions.html): one git worktree per session, each in its own terminal.
- [How to know which coding agent is waiting for you]({{SITE}}/answers/know-which-agent-needs-you.html): hooks, notify, and the cc wall.
- [How to check whether an agent's tests catch bugs]({{SITE}}/answers/check-agent-tests-catch-bugs.html): mutation testing by hand, and with Proof, part of cc Pro.
